messages:
Support-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert — hosted-infer-usw1 p99 latency 5.6s, 5xx rate 1.8% over 10m. Auto-escalation to #eng-sre.
Alex: Noticed multiple customer tickets about timeouts + 502/504s on /v1/generate. Spike started ~3581231000. Any quick triage pointers?
Sam: Pulling logs/dashboards. p50 looks fine, tail is the problem. Error class shows many upstream auth validation timeouts (504) rather than model exec failures.
Maria: Querying logs now. Example query I'm running in Loki: `{service="gateway", path="/v1/generate"} | json | status=~"5.." | line_format "{request_id} {status} {auth_error}"` — filtering for auth_error ~ "timeout".
Alex: Running Maria's query — ~230 504s in last 10m, top request_ids present but most traces are missing (sampling not showing spans).
Jordan: Did anyone change tracer sampling? I pushed a config tweak to reduce traces last night for cost. If sampling dropped, we lose root cause context.
Irina: Auth team metrics show auth-service.request_duration.p95 jumped to ~850ms around the same time. Also saw a burst of 429s from the billing/token quota service ~3581230800. Paging auth/billing.
Sam: Hypothesis: auth service hit a downstream rate limit (billing/KMS), causing validation to timeout and gateway to surface 504s. Logs show a handful of 429s prior to the 504 ramp.
Maria: Repro steps to validate locally: run a small concurrent flood against gateway with expired/valid tokens to exercise auth path. Bash snippet: `for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST https://api.hosted.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' & done` — when auth returns 504 locally we reproduce the gateway 504s.
Alex: Temporary mitigation — enabling fallback policy to route requests to a smaller model-variant and bypass heavy auth synchronous paths for non-sensitive requests. Rolling to 10% now.
Jordan: Added a dashboard panel with direct log links and a Count(504)/10m graph. Also adjusted alert threshold: trigger when 5xx fraction > 1% over 5m (was 0.5%).
Irina: Request: tracing-team, can you bump gateway sampler to 0.2 for the next 30m so we capture traces for the next wave? @tracing-team
tracing-team: Acknowledged — bumping sampler in us-west gateway to 0.2 for 30m. Will post when done.
Sam: Collecting top 50 request_ids and handoff to auth team. Creating INC-12345 for auth/billing correlation and attaching logs + sample traces (where available).
Support-bot: Ticket INC-12345 created and linked to customer cases. Notifying support + account teams.
Alex: Thx — keep updates here. If fallback reduces customer hits and auth team confirms remediation, we'll revert the rollout slowly. :thumbsup:
Maria: Follow-up: add a short-lived runbook note for this pattern (auth -> billing throttle -> gateway 504) with the above log queries and mitigation steps. I'll draft and drop into runbooks channel.
Sam: Monitoring p99 and 5xx rate. Will report back in 10m.
